aioe_soc.label: Felten-Raj-Seamans AIOE
aioe_soc.note: Rank correlation with an independent measure we did not fit on: first vs our Eloundou AI sub-score (like-for-like), then vs the full displacement blend.

headline: Across 702 occupations, our risk ranking separates real 2020-2025 outcomes: the highest-risk decile lost 8.0% of jobs on average while the lowest-risk decile grew 17.4%, and it ranks a declining occupation above a growing one 69% of the time (AUC 0.686). Individual prediction stays weak, so results are shown as ranges, not point verdicts.
caveat: The 2020 base year is the COVID shock; employment change partly reflects pandemic recovery, not automation. Raw AI exposure is statistically insignificant here; AI's large labour effects are recent/prospective, so a weak in-sample AI signal is expected and honest.
